title: An Act to Abolish Ranked-choice Voting

summary.text:
This bill repeals the laws governing ranked-choice voting in:

1. Primary elections for the offices of President of the United States, United States Senator, United States Representative to Congress, Governor, State Senator and State Representative; 2. General and special elections for the offices of United States Senator and United States Representative to Congress; and 3. General elections for presidential electors.
